draft.subject: Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Shakti Cement
draft.body:
Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Shakti Cement

Dear Shakti Cement Team,

Following a mechanical breakdown, we have dispatched a replacement vehicle (Reg: PB18BK2160) from our Ludhiana hub to continue your route to Lucknow. The original vehicle (Reg: PB84TB2343) has been secured and is undergoing inspection. The new ETA is approximately 21.6 hours, which remains within our committed 36-hour door-to-door window. We will provide further updates as the shipment progresses.

Best regards,
Meridian Freight Dispatch
